HexKagune 1.0.22 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 42). Testing build.

- **War and Peace use the same ability panel as every other form:** same card, same spot above the chat, your bound keys, with cooldowns on it.
- **Hold K with the kagune out now works:** the kagune goes in, then War or Peace comes on. Before, it only put the kagune away.
- **R takes War or Peace off** (with the detransform), like it puts every other form away.
